lede: US markets are shut for Thanksgiving after hotter October PCE data and a 4.3% Q3 GDP revision left a December Fed hike almost fully priced. Gold bounced back toward $3,580 from a one-year low near $3,428, while the S&P 500 dipped 0.25% as Nvidia slid almost 4%.

focus.text: Dropped to 3,428 on strong US data, then recovered to about 3,580 as yields eased; trades above its 3,532 pivot. Liquidity is thin with US markets closed.
Edged up to around 1.098 as the dollar softened late; Fed and ECB December hikes are both priced in. Today's ECB account of the October meeting is the main event.

news.text: October core PCE ran at 3.3% y/y, a near three-year high, and Q3 GDP was revised to 4.3%; futures price roughly 97% odds of a 9 Dec hike.
Washington is reportedly preparing higher tariffs on China, the EU and others; the USTR says most rates mirror existing deals, and Beijing has pushed back.
Crude jumped on Wednesday after Houthi rebels claimed a strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery; damage has not been independently confirmed.
Nvidia lost 3.9% to $149.30 and the Nasdaq fell 0.6% as AI-spending worries persisted; Korea's Kospi had dropped over 6% earlier on chip selling.
ECB's Sleijpen signalled a likely December rate rise, while a Reuters poll sees the BoJ hiking to 1.5% in December with USD/JPY near 159.
US spot bitcoin ETFs posted a sixth straight day of outflows through 24 Nov; November redemptions near $4.9B are the largest monthly total since launch.
The Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Act passed the House Financial Services Committee; it would block sales of reserve BTC for at least 20 years.
A CFTC staff advisory lets exchanges and clearinghouses count BTC, ETH and payment stablecoins toward reserves, subject to haircuts.
Injective activated its Veyra mainnet upgrade aimed at tokenised real-world assets, and Sei rolled out its v6.8 upgrade.
HUMA unlocks about 14% of circulating supply today, with FF releasing roughly 6% on 29 Nov.
Bitcoin climbed back above $60K after dipping near $57.2K, but the Fear & Greed index sits at an extreme-fear reading of 11.
